{{Quote|I have a vague idea how many ships there are in a squadron, you know.''"<br />"''Yes, of course, sir. I know that, but given that the Verpine normally count in base six and humans use base ten, twelve, which to a Verpine is known as ''four fists'', the potential for confusion warranted explanation.|Wedge Antilles and Emtrey|<ref name="rogue">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>}}
A '''fist''' was a number in the [[Verpine (language)|Verpine]] that was roughly equivalent to three in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. Four fists were equivalent to a dozen, while forty-eight fists referred to a [[gross]].<ref name="rogue" />
